bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 71
flag=$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 printenv GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED || :)
if test "$flag" = enabled; then echo NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FLAG=ENABLED; else echo NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FLAG=NOT_ENABLED; fi
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT state,count(*) FROM announcement_notifications GROUP BY state ORDER BY state"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT coalesce(payload->>'action','none'),state,count(*) FROM announcement_notifications WHERE created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY payload->>'action',state ORDER BY 1,2"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT status,count(*) FROM announcement_applications GROUP BY status ORDER BY status"
echo ROOM_APPLICATION_NOTIFICATION_READBACK_COMPLETE
